standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."

Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. 🧳 A traveler swears Ashford, northwest, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Ashford is starving.)

Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 The Cache. At dawn the System's surveyors map every hidden food cache in the valley. Tonight you move the winter store — every move the cameras catch is taxed. Move it all. Let them see nothing.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The announcement scrolls across the sky: AT DAWN, THE SURVEYORS MAP EVERY HIDDEN CACHE IN THE VALLEY.

Tonight, the winter store moves — sacks, bundles, the smoked meat, all of it. Every move the cameras catch is taxed. Move it all. Let them see nothing.

📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Wilhelm opens the pantry wide: 5× Expedition haul. Caleb, Yuki, Emma, Sanne and 1 more eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,500 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

💛 You hold Dog tags. Not yours. Kurt's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Kurt would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
